title: API Server & Companion
description: The companion app's REST API and WebSocket: asks to the zone over the bus, auth, map caches, live sockets, web push.

panels.title: Zone asks / s
panels.description: Questions sent to the zone over the bus.

panels.title: Ask p95
panels.description: 95th percentile wait for the zone's answer, every query type. The request timeout is 5 s.

panels.title: Asks failing / s
panels.description: Timeouts, no zone listening, bus errors and BUSY refusals.

panels.title: Open sockets
panels.description: Companion WebSockets on this instance.

panels.title: Requests refused by auth / s
panels.description: 401, 429 and ticket lookups that hit a zone failure, answered by the auth filter.

panels.title: HTTP 5xx / s
panels.description: Server errors across every route.

panels.title: Asks by result
panels.description: How each question ended. Anything but ok and not_modified is a user-visible error or a refusal.

panels.title: Ask latency
panels.description: Time from sending to the zone's reply. Red line: the 5 s request timeout.

panels.title: Ask p95 by query
panels.description: Which questions are slow.

panels.title: Asks by query
panels.description: Where the zone's request load comes from.

panels.title: Failed asks by query
panels.description: Timeouts, unavailable, error and busy, per query type.

panels.title: Requests awaiting a reply
panels.description: Pending correlation ids in the bus client: asks sent, not yet answered or timed out.

panels.title: Bus errors
panels.description: Counted inside the bus client, below the per-query timer.

panels.title: Replies dropped
panels.description: Orphans arrive after the caller gave up (or were never ours); unreadable ones failed to decode.

panels.title: Asks sent
panels.description: Requests published to the zone, from the bus client's own count.

panels.title: Events delivered
panels.description: Stream entries handed to the fan-out and push listeners.

panels.title: Stream failures
panels.description: Listener exceptions, entries that would not decode, and failed reads that were retried.

panels.title: Events fanned out by type
panels.description: What the zone tells the app about.

panels.title: Token failures by reason
panels.description: Companion tokens that did not verify, on REST and on the socket's first frame.

panels.title: Requests refused by the filter
panels.description: By what the caller presented and the status it got. 5xx: the zone could not answer a ticket lookup.

panels.title: Rate-limit denials
panels.description: Calls refused for using up the per-minute budget; map=true is the separate, larger map budget.

panels.title: Ticket lookups
panels.description: Game-client tickets resolved from memory, or by asking the zone.

panels.title: Refused by route
panels.description: Which part of the API is turning callers away.

panels.title: Rate-limit denial share
panels.description: Share of all REST calls turned away by the limiter.

panels.title: Cached-content outcomes by route
panels.description: How tile, overlay and emblem requests were answered: served_from_zone, client_304, cache_revalidated, evicted_refetch, cache_hit.

panels.title: Body bytes sent
panels.description: Image bytes written to callers (JSON overlays are not sized).

panels.title: Tile requests the zone had to render
panels.description: Share of tile requests that needed a fresh answer from the zone rather than a 304 or cached bytes.

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: Hits over lookups per cache. answers: per-account zone answers (5 s); emblems; tile_bytes: PNGs by ETag.

panels.title: Cache size
panels.description: Entries held (the weighted caches are bounded in bytes, not entries).

panels.title: Cache evictions
panels.description: Entries pushed out by size or weight (expiry counts too).

panels.title: Open sockets and accounts
panels.description: Live on this instance.

panels.title: Socket opens by auth result
panels.description: Unauthorized: the first frame carried no valid companion token.

panels.title: Frames written
panels.description: One per socket per event, plus ready and replay frames.

panels.title: Send and keep-alive failures
panels.description: overflow: the socket's send buffer or time limit ran out (the decorator closes it).

panels.title: Expiries and replays
panels.description: expired: closed because the token ran out. replayed: events sent to a socket that reconnected with a last event id.

panels.title: Cache invalidations from events
panels.description: What zone events dropped: a player's cached answers, a master's tile etags, a left player's tickets.

panels.title: Push outcomes
panels.description: delivered, gone (subscription deleted), failed (kept for next time).

panels.title: Events not pushed
panels.description: unwanted: preference or quiet hours; online: the player is in the world or has a socket; rate_limit: the hourly cap.

panels.title: Push service latency
panels.description: p95 per answer class of the push service's HTTP reply.

panels.title: Requests by route
panels.description: http.server.requests by URI template; the auth filter's own 401/429 are under UNKNOWN.

panels.title: Latency p95 by route
panels.description: Includes the wait on the zone for routes that ask it.
